title: Notes app with Markdown, search and autosave
when: The user wants a notes app: a list of notes, an editor, search and autosave in the browser, with simple Markdown formatting in the view mode.
prompt:
Goal: A two pane notes app that never loses text, finds notes instantly and renders formatting without unsafe HTML.
Steps:
1. Note { id, title, body, updatedAt }; when title is empty use the first line of the body.
2. Sidebar list (newest first) with a search input, and an editor textarea with a View toggle; one pane at a time under 700 px with a Back button.
3. Autosave: debounce input 400 ms, set updatedAt, write localStorage notes.v1 in try and catch, show "Saved" in a role="status" element.
4. logic.mjs: createNote, updateNote, deleteNote, searchNotes over title and body, sortByUpdated, parseMarkdown(text) returning a token tree.
5. Turn tokens into nodes with createElement and textContent; links only for http, https and mailto.
6. Delete with an Undo button for 5 seconds; export all notes as a .md download.
7. test.mjs: search, order, title fallback, and that parseMarkdown keeps <script> as text.
Quality bar:
- Typing never lags on a long note.
- Closing the tab mid edit keeps the text.
- Search ignores case and accents.
Pitfalls:
- Writing storage on every keystroke.
- javascript: links in rendered notes.
- The selected note vanishing when a search clears.
Verify:
- [ ] Reload restores notes and the last open one.
- [ ] Rendered view has no innerHTML from note text.
- [ ] Saved status is announced.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js (panes, autosave, rendering), logic.mjs (notes and Markdown tokens), test.mjs.

examples.input: quero um app de anotacoes simples com busca
examples.output: sidebar + editor, debounce autosave, View mode with headings and lists, notes.v1
